name: Survey tile in Ophiucus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Ophiucus, imaged by SPHEREx 37 times in 13 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 74 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-08-11, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
